captured_counter_window.scope: Actual per-server first/final ct_test status read intervals; includes ambient JVM work between reads. No new observations or timing interpolation.

scope_notes.counter_window: Main-path counter_end precedes final conservation drain: cost per fixed input window, not the complete drained resource lifecycle. Backpressure includes its recovery before counter_end. Tail SQL/WAL work is not backfilled.
scope_notes.transactions: Completed backend worker tasks; not database commits. Use db_transactions for successful SQL transactions.
scope_notes.db_statements: Instrumented Sql.query/update call attempts, including retries/failures; excludes JDBC transaction controls and statements outside those helpers. Distinct from account-wide performance_schema events.
scope_notes.batch_devices: Device appearances processed by batch calls; not a count of distinct fixture endpoints.
scope_notes.batch_records: Records processed by batch calls; not a count of SQL statements or external business events.
scope_notes.local_credit_publications: Includes credits delivered after cross-server SQL allocation; cannot identify same-server-source fast-path hits.
scope_notes.WAL: Absent keys are UNMEASURED, never zero. Writes/bytes are independent cost counters; no SQL/WAL/local resource copies are added.

WAL_barrier_snapshots.scope: Per-JVM last-at-most-2048 completed journal barriers at each status read. Includes file force, atomic move and directory force. Window age is unknown; snapshots may include prior phases. Do not subtract percentiles/sample counts, pool JVM percentiles or call these phase-wide p95 values.

pressure_detail.timer_scope: Per-server end rings/avg100 recorded snapshots; unknown window age, no pooled/subtracted percentiles or full-phase/native TPS claim.
pressure_detail.recovery_first_output_scope: Reconstructed single-observer recovery-entry to first successful capability pull interval; first_actual_output_ms is reply-end delay, not precise mutation time or new source-to-target E2E.

frozen_goals.scope: Same/cross/mixed30% DB reduction is assessed per identical240-input main window; samep95 reduction40%, crossp95 max regression20%. Pressure/hotspot are separate workloads, not substitutes. Default10% flags are separate.925 B/C and primary goals remain unmeasured here.

limits.fixed_input: Backpressure:240x32000FE plus120s intentional no-extraction hold, quiet interval and recovery. Hotspot:240 rounds x7 sources (four hot/three cold),1680x32000FE. All individual source attempts/accepted amounts retained.
limits.counter_window: Backpressure includes recovery and drain before counter_end. Hotspot and primary normal paths capture counter_end before final conservation drain; tail SQL/WAL cost is unmeasured, not reconstructed from conservation.
limits.assets: Independent all-phase event ledgers and latest per-channel conservation checkpoints match; SQL/local/WAL mirrors are never added. Repeated cumulative checkpoints are never summed.
limits.WAL: Original counts/bytes/barriers and helper/batch counters are UNMEASURED.753 actual counters and per-server ring snapshots retained without a baseline WAL reduction claim.
limits.fairness: Actual successful pulls and phase-edge gaps; deliberate backpressure hold dominates~122s gaps. No pending eligible-demand latency is inferred. Every sink served in each repeat.
limits.latency: No low-flow probes or per-packet trace identity in pressure. Recovery first-output reply-end delay is not source-to-target E2E, and overlapped steady inputs have no invented latency percentile.
limits.observer: All12 drive/hold windows retained planned/actual rounds, lateness and saturation. Given-load output/recovery does not establish factory capacity. Sequential RCON/tick/cap budgets can bound observed recovery.
limits.RCON: Single business observer; old shared console body buffer lacks per-command nonce and complete raw business replies. Fixed-input, prefix, static-probe and resource checks retained; no wrong amount/time demonstrated.
limits.version: Original archived87 runtime vs exact753 pressure. Checkout HEAD and future925 performance are separate;753 B/C never ran. Selected assets are tied through matching preceding container PID/world/session/argv, not class-loader CodeSource.
limits.timers: Raw per-server end-ring/avg100 snapshots retained as diagnostics, without pooled/subtracted percentiles, phase-wide MSPT or instantaneous TPS claims.
